requirements: R1: Implement real OAuth2/OIDC token exchange and user profile fetch against the Moodle identity provider.
R2: Load Moodle OAuth2 client ID and secret from the application configuration.

slices.title: Implement real Moodle OAuth2 token exchange and configuration
slices.jtbd: When implementing the Moodle OAuth2 flow for this epic, I want to exchange the authorization code using configured client credentials, so that the SSO integration is secure and relies on real data.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given valid Moodle OAuth2 client configuration, When a user provides an authorization code, Then the system exchanges it for a token and fetches the Moodle profile.
Given the SSO flow, When the token exchange completes, Then automated tests verify the integration without relying on hardcoded mock tokens.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce mock token usage in Moodle SSO from 100% to 0%
